resources.string: Optindex reads the text in your screenshots and images and can recognize what they show, and builds a search index on this device. Allow access to your images to get started.
This app has no internet permission. Android blocks every network connection for it — internet, local network and even localhost. Text recognition and smart search run completely on your device.

Text: the text in the images is read for text search. Smart: the images are analyzed so you can search by describing them. Only images in chosen folders are scanned and shown. Results of folders you turn off are kept, so turning them on again is instant.

All models are built into the app. Each extra language makes scanning a bit slower.
English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Polish, Turkish, … plus Chinese and Japanese
Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian, Bulgarian, Serbian, Macedonian, …
Best at finding small text. Recommended.
About 1.5× faster. A small model reads clear text, only unclear lines get the full model. May miss very small text.
The new setting applies to images scanned from now on. Images that were already scanned can be scanned again with it, which takes a while.
Find images by describing them in English, e.g. \"dog on a beach\" or \"pizza\". Works fully offline.
Smaller model, analyzes images faster. Matches are less reliable.
Higher shows fewer images that match better

The new model applies to images analyzed from now on. Images that were already analyzed can be analyzed again with it. Until then they are still found with the old model.
